name: growdaily-admin-lookup
description: Local admin tool: a live dashboard of what every GrowDaily account is doing (server.js), with a full per-account report you can step back through day by day, or a one-page HTML report for one account (lookup_user.js). Read-only for accounts, loopback-only. The Wording page (/wording) is the one part that writes, and it writes only the app's text edits (wording/live and its history), never an account. Not part of the app; never deployed.
